summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of common stock and warrants. The company sold 410,998 shares at $7.056 per share, with an equal number of warrants exercisable at same price for five years, raising ~$2.9M gross. No premium expressed or board recommendation noted; the offering priced at a premium to Nasdaq minimum. The offering closes June 24, 2026; resale registration required within 30 days. This is a routine equity financing, not a special-situation event; risk-arb not applicable.
